external_tools.name: gmcli
external_tools.purpose: QR-paired Google Messages (Android SMS/RCS) archive query
external_tools.install_hint: See github.com/johnlindquist/gmkit. Beta, single maintainer, no numbered release tags.

refresh_policy.rationale: Google Messages access requires a one-time QR pairing (`gmcli auth`, run manually by the user outside this connector) with an Android phone that must stay online and reachable for gmcli to sync. Pairing/session tokens require full manual re-pairing after roughly 14 days of inactivity, so an unattended background schedule cannot be relied on to keep working.

public_listing.rationale: Requires a real gmcli binary (github.com/johnlindquist/gmkit, beta, single maintainer, AGPL-3.0) and a real QR-paired Google Messages account; not yet proven against a live paired device.

streams.name: messages
streams.description: Google Messages read from the paired Android device's local gmcli archive: `gmcli --json --full chats list` enumerates conversations, then `gmcli messages list --conv <id> --json --full --limit <N> --order asc` fetches each conversation's messages (Message rows — verified from github.com/johnlindquist/gmkit's internal/store/messages.go source: message_id, conversation_id, source_platform, sender_id, body, timestamp_ms, is_from_me). This is a different, complete-listing command from `messages search` (which requires a query term and returns a different struct meant for keyword search) — this connector never uses search for archive collection. No exotic fields (reactions, media, reply-threading, RCS-vs-SMS transport distinction) are claimed. Media attachments are not downloaded (gmcli media download is out of scope). BOUNDED: gmcli's CLI exposes only a flat --limit (no pagination cursor) — this connector caps messages per conversation (GMCLI_MESSAGES_PER_CHAT_LIMIT, default 500) and conversations scanned per run (GMCLI_MAX_CHATS, default 200); a conversation that returns a full page is flagged via a `gmcli_per_chat_limit_reached` SKIP_RESULT and a coverage_diagnostics reason, never silently presented as complete history. Resume is best-effort only — gmcli's exact resume-cursor semantics were not independently verified from source.

display.label: Your Google Messages
display.detail: Message id, conversation id/name, sender identifier, body text, sent timestamp, and direction (from/to you) for each message in the gmcli-synced archive, bounded per conversation. Requires the Android device to have been QR-paired via `gmcli auth` (run manually by you) and to remain online for gmcli to sync.

streams.name: coverage_diagnostics
streams.description: Safe coverage status for this connector's one known local store (the gmcli-synced message archive), so a local-collector run always leaves durable, honest coverage evidence even when gmcli is missing, unpaired, or fails to query — never a silent zero-evidence run.

display.label: Local collector coverage status
display.detail: Whether gmcli was found, paired, and successfully queried on this run.
